changes: Hold FIX, SAMPLER or LFO for about half a second (counted in UI ticks) with no turn to look at the amounts: the release then does nothing. A quick tap still toggles fixed velocity, opens the recorder or opens the LFO page. With LFO held, a value passed to stock's locker by a module (MIDI, for one) sets the LFO's depth by its change, not only the Rytm's encoder.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
